description: The Andhra Pradesh High Court flagged discrepancies in an affidavit, calling it AI-generated and reminding advocates of their duty towards both clients and the court.
body_lead: Advising that artificial intelligence (AI) should be used as a tool and not as a master substitute, the Andhra Pradesh High Court recently, while hearing a writ petition, declared an attached affidavit to be a “product of artificial intelligence” and directed the advocates to be “careful” with the tool. Justice Subba Reddy Satti was hearing a plea filed by the petitioner seeking directions to the authorities to conduct an investigation based on his complaint written on January 5, 2023, and, consequently, to register an FIR.
